app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.
info.title: Crawlora API

get.description: Returns the site-wide CS2 round win rate for every pairing of buy levels (rounds, wins, win rate), the baseline to compare a team's `economy` view of bo3-team-stats with. Levels: -1 full eco, 0 semi-eco, 1 half buy, 2 full buy; the opposing level is null when it is unknown.

Returns BO3.gg forum threads for one game with paging: a `category` id from bo3-forum-categories and `sort` (`activity` with pinned threads first, `newest`, `comments`, `rating`), up to 100 per page. Each thread has slug, title, category, comment count, rating, pinned flag, created and last-activity times and the author's nickname; post bodies, reactions and replies are not returned.

parameters.description: Game; one of cs2, valorant, lol, dota2, r6siege, mlbb; defaults to cs2
parameters.name: game

parameters.description: Forum category id from bo3-forum-categories, for example 4
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Order; one of activity, newest, comments, rating; defaults to activity
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Zero-based offset; defaults to 0
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 100; defaults to 20
parameters.name: limit

get.summary: BO3.gg forum threads with category and sort filters

get.description: Returns one BO3.gg match by slug: teams with scores and winner, status, best-of, tier, start and end time, tournament, stage and round, the maps played with scores, the site's AI prediction, live and recorded streams and the key-fact insights for each team. The slug comes from bo3-match-history.

parameters.description: Match slug from bo3-match-history, for example vitality-vs-natus-vincere-27-10-2026

get.description: Returns the maps of one BO3.gg match with round-by-round results: for each map the number, map name, state, start, duration in seconds, final score, per-half side results (CT or T score, overtime) and every round with its number, duration, end reason, winning side and running score. A match with no maps yet returns an empty list.

parameters.description: Numeric BO3 match id (the id of a bo3-match-history row)
parameters.name: match_id

get.summary: BO3.gg esports match maps with round-by-round results

get.description: Returns BO3.gg's esports match history for one game, newest first by default, with paging and filters: `status` (`finished`, `defwin`, `upcoming`, `current`, `canceled`, `postponed`; the default is finished and default-win matches together), `tier` (`s` to `d`), an inclusive `from`/`to` day range (UTC), `sort` and `offset`/`limit` (up to 100 per page). Each match has teams, scores, winner, best-of, tournament, maps and the site's AI prediction; `total` and `has_more` page through the full history.

parameters.name: game

parameters.description: Match status; one of finished, defwin, upcoming, current, canceled, postponed; defaults to finished and defwin together
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Tournament tier; one of s, a, b, c, d
parameters.name: tier

parameters.description: First start day, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC, inclusive)
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Last start day, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC, inclusive)
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Order by start time; one of newest, oldest; defaults to newest
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Zero-based offset; defaults to 0
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 100; defaults to 20
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns every player's statistics for one BO3.gg match, ordered by team then nickname: kills, deaths, assists, headshots, first kills and deaths, trades, KAST, rating, ADR, damage, utility and money figures as a numeric `stats` map, plus the multikill counts (2K to 5K), team and opponent. The match slug comes from bo3-match-history.

parameters.description: Match slug from bo3-match-history, for example vitality-vs-natus-vincere-27-10-2026

get.description: Returns the BO3.gg editorial categories (id and title, sorted by title: Analytics, Article, Blog, Events, Gaming, Guides, Highlights, Interviews, News, Predictions, Results, Streams, Tips, Transfers, Wiki) accepted by the `category` filter of bo3-news-feed.

Returns BO3.gg's editorial feed for one game with paging and filters: `section` (`news`, `article`, `wiki`, `predictions`, `reviews`), a `locale` (16 languages, `en` by default), a `category` id from bo3-news-categories and `sort` (`newest`, `oldest`), up to 100 per page. Each item has slug, title, description, category, publish time, author, tags, image and canonical URL; `total` and `has_more` page through the archive (over 100,000 items across games).

parameters.description: Language of the items; one of en, ru, pt, es, de, fr, tr, pl, id, vi, ja, ko, ua, ms, tl, da; defaults to en

get.description: Returns BO3.gg's CS2 player leaderboard over a day range (default: the last six months): players ranked by `sort` (`rating`, `kd`, `kills`, `damage`, `assists`, `headshots`, `games`, `rounds`) in `order` (`desc`, `asc`), optionally limited to games at one tournament `tier` (`s` to `d`), with paging. Each player has team, games, rounds and every per-game average as a `stats` map; players below the API's minimum-games threshold for the window are excluded (`min_games_count`). CS2 only.

get.description: Returns BO3.gg's CS2 records (standout single-game and single-round performances such as best shots accuracy, clutches, multikills, damage, win streaks) with paging. Scope them to one `match`, `tournament`, `team` or `player` slug, filter by `record_type` (for example `game_player_headshots`), restrict the game day range with `from`/`to`, and order `newest` or `oldest`. Unscoped requests cover the last six months; each record has its value, unit, side, map, round, player, team and opponents.

parameters.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); unscoped default is six months before to
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); unscoped default is today
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Record type such as game_player_headshots or game_round_player_clutch; the types present are listed in the response
parameters.name: record_type

parameters.description: Match slug to scope the records to one match
parameters.name: match

parameters.description: Tournament slug to scope the records to one tournament
parameters.name: tournament

parameters.description: Team slug to scope the records to one team
parameters.name: team

parameters.description: Player slug to scope the records to one player
parameters.name: player

parameters.description: Order by game time; one of newest, oldest; defaults to newest
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Zero-based offset; defaults to 0
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 100; defaults to 20
parameters.name: limit

Rows carry rank, rank change, points, region, country and the five-player roster with ratings.
